pages.title: Game Over
pages.text: The game over jingle of Earthworm Jim (Shiny Entertainment, 1994) lasts only about four seconds. VGMPF lists its composer as unknown.

pages.title: No passwords
pages.text: According to Sega Retro, Shiny Entertainment were first against putting a password system into Earthworm Jim, because they believed that it would make the game too easy. They gave in only for the Sega CD version.
